{{Quote|Thanks for the tip, Sahr. We couldn't of set this one up without you.|Larken thanks his new partner for the information used to set up the ambush|<ref name="A Buyer's Guide to Alternative Starships">{{JournalCite|5|A Buyer's Guide to Alternative Starships}}</ref>}}
A pre-planned '''ambush''' took place close to the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Darknon Station]]<ref name="A Buyer's Guide to Alternative Starships" /> on the [[Itani Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|Hyperlane]]<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref> in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The conflict involved three [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] aiming to capture a [[Helix-class light interceptor|''Helix''-class light interceptor]]. The pirates, lead by an individual named [[Larken]], had been tipped off to the fact that the interceptor was headed for the station by a [[Gender/Legends|female]] named [[Sahr]] who joined them as Larken's gunner and partner on board his vessel ''[[Pillage]]''. The group, which also included the ships ''[[Trust Me]]'' and [[Profit (pirate ship)|''Profit'']], waited under the cover of an [[Ion storm/Legends|magnetic storm]] for their target's arrival with the ''Pillage'' waiting in a position to prevent the target doubling back and escaping. When their target, which was named the ''[[Kizbon's Box]]'', arrived the three moved to attack what they believed was an unarmed vessel only to discover it was armed with [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedos]], which it used to destroy ''Trust Me''. After seeing the destruction of the other ship the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of ''Profit'', named [[Druug]], began to curse before his ship two was obliterated, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him. In the only remaining vessel, Larken fired several shots at the ''Box'' but did almost no damage and afterwards the [[Unidentified pilot (Kizbon's Box)|pilot]] of the opposing vessel contacted Larken and Sahr by [[Comlink/Legends|comm]], addressing them both by name.<ref name="A Buyer's Guide to Alternative Starships" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ambush first appeared in [[1995]] the article "[[A Buyer's Guide to Alternative Starships]]" which was published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|fifth]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' series of supplement books for [[West End Games]], ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The article was written by [[Stephen Luminati]] and included two short stories to illustrate some of the ships mentioned. The conflict appeared in one of these, titled "''Kizbon's Box''" which gave no information as to what era it was set in.
